name: 2x Money
description: Doubles the money all your plants make. Works offline and when you sell, too.

name: 2x Speed
description: Doubles all the Speed you get from walking and from the treadmill.

name: 2x Luck
description: The seeds you steal roll with double luck, so rare ones show up a lot more often.

name: VIP
